SELECT /* 1. 오늘 점검 전체 개수 */ SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayTotal,
SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspections i WHERE i.facility_id = f.facility_id AND TRUNC(i.submitted_at) = TRUNC(f.next_scheduled_at) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCompleted FROM facilities f

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS untilYesterdayTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inspections i WHERE i.facility_id = f.facility_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS untilYesterdayCompleted, SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upcomingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inspections i WHERE i.facility_id = f.facility_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueUninspected FROM facilities f
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citizen_reports cr WHERE cr.status = 'PENDING'
